Hi Samantha —

Wanted to share a short renewal health snapshot and a couple of concrete term options for HelioHealth ahead of your renewal window (Mar 1). High level: your aggregate token spend has been steady but concentrated in two workloads (inference text gen & embedding refreshes). We pulled performance logs for the last 90 days and flagged three small latency degradations during peak batch windows — ops mitigations reduced the tail, but the pattern suggests you could benefit from a higher dedicated capacity floor or an embedding cache.

Key numbers (Nov–Dec 2027):
- Avg monthly token consumption: ~620M tokens
- 90th pct latency (gen pipeline): 320ms (target 250ms) during peak
- Embedding refreshes: 18M embeddings/month, ~35% duplication across batches

Proposed options (attached spreadsheet 'renewal_options_helio_v2.xlsx'):
A) 12-month reserved capacity (commit) to cover current run-rate + 25% headroom — ~750M tokens/mo equivalent; includes 5% unit discount and 99.9% uptime SLA.
B) 24-month tiered commit with built-in burst credits for seasonal spikes (cheaper unit price year 2), plus an embeddings cache pilot (3 months).
C) Keep pay-as-you-go, add a dedicated optimizer review + 10% discount credit for switching to the dedicated plan within 30 days.

Notes / asks:
- Samantha, can you confirm which option you want priced versus an adoption ramp?
- Procurement: do you need a workback on procurement steps / PO lead time?
- Internal: Ben and Lauren, I copied you to prep a succinct MvP ROI analysis for option B (embeddings cache benefit + cost delta).

Attachments:
- renewal_options_helio_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call next week to walk through options.

Best,
Priyom

3) Mid-Feb: Procurement sends PO draft; we provide standard contract addendum for tiered pricing.

- renewal_options_helio_v2.xlsx (pricing & option matrix)
